structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and Boards Within the Department
Soil Scientists, Wetland Professionals, and Geologists

law.catch_line: Requirements for application for professional wetland delineator certification
law.text:
The Board may certify any applicant as a Virginia certified professional wetland delineator who has submitted satisfactory evidence verified by affidavits that the applicant:
Is eighteen years of age or older;
Is of good moral character; and
Has successfully completed such educational and experiential requirements as are required by this chapter and the regulations of the Board.
